rules.rules_primary: If Walker Kessler leads the NBA in total plus/minus for the 2026-27 regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules.rules_secondary:
Only regular season statistics count. Statistics from the preseason, playoffs (including the Play-In Tournament), the All-Star Game, and the NBA Cup Championship game are excluded. NBA Cup games before the Championship game are part of the regular season and do count. If a player is traded or otherwise plays for more than one team during the season, his statistics from all teams are combined.

In the event of a tie among multiple players, “Yes” positions will pay $1/N (rounded down to the nearest cent), where N is the number of tied players, and “No” positions will pay 1 minus the "Yes" payout
